Name: PoseToAttr
Description: Will save current pose to an attr via SDK

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Will save current pose to an attr via SDK.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetObject: set the node/object name this block should use.
- NewAttrName: set the node/object name this block should use.
- SetNewAttrNode: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- AnimStep: set the node/object name this block should use.

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
